title: Image resizer settings
description: Settings for one resize job or preset (Module 1). Width/height are in 'unit'; px values must be whole numbers.

dpi.description: Dots per inch written into the file (and used to turn cm/mm/in into pixels).

sizeMode.description: What stays fixed when you change DPI: the pixel size or the physical size.

fitDpi.description: Physical units only: store the density that makes the physical size exact after rounding to whole pixels.

fit.description: crop = fill and cut off the excess, pad = fit inside and fill the rest with padColor, stretch = change proportions.

padColor.description: Padding colour, and the background used when transparency must be flattened for JPEG.

quality.description: JPEG/WEBP quality when no maximum size is set.

sizeRange.description: Target file size. Leave out (or null) for no target.

subsampling.description: JPEG chroma subsampling. auto lets the size search pick the better-looking option.

stripMetadata.description: Remove camera, GPS, XMP, comments and colour profile. DPI is always kept.

allowPadding.description: If the best quality is still below the minimum size, add harmless padding (pixels untouched).

allowQuantize.description: PNG only: allow reducing colours (lossy) to reach the maximum size.

saveOutOfRange.description: Save the closest result even when the size range cannot be met.
